_doc: PROPOSAL (task M3-01), not game data. Apprentice robots (spec section 3). mastery_speed: a robot works a kind at rate x (base + per_level x Lumi's mastery of that kind), and not at all below min_level. near_bonus: extra speed for crew in the district Lumi is in (the simulator treats the whole current district as 'within 80 m'). types: kinds = pollution kinds the type can work; rate = units a second per robot at speed 1.0; water_rate / plant_rate = hexes a second a tender waters or plants; hauls = carries Lumi's bales to the scale, each covering haul_share of the carrying; cost {cubes, parts} for the first one, then x cost_growth (cubes) and x parts_growth (Parts) per robot owned of that type; requires = id that must be owned; district = index of the district that must be open; cap = most robots of that type at base level 1..6 (the columns add up to the spec's crew sizes 3, 6, 10, 14, 18, 24). tiers: Mk tiers; mult = work speed; cost_mult (cubes) and parts_mult (Parts) x the type's first cost x robots owned = price to refit the whole type; requires = id; Planet 1 stops at Mk II. 'sootcap' is a working name for the smog robot.
